decision: MEASUREMENT_INVALID — Infrastructure failure: the mock server never applied brotli/gzip compression (Content-Encoding='none' on all 2880 observations, run_experiment.py:260-301). The decompression-normalization mechanism (SHA256 on decompressed body via brotli.decompress/gzip.decompress) was never exercised. The frozen question asked about behavior 'under brotli/gzip compression without CDN noise' but the environment could not express this effect. All reported discrimination metrics (0.5) reflect identity-path body hashing, not decompression-normalization. The frozen falsifier's third disjunct (brotli quality diversity does not increase) technically triggers but is uninformative because no compression was applied. C-MEAS-VALID does not advance from this experiment.

The frozen question 'under brotli/gzip compression without CDN noise' was not instantiated. Reported discrimination 0.5 equals compressed discrimination 0.5 trivially (identity path). The frozen decision_rule clause 'MEASUREMENT_INVALID if infrastructure failure prevents valid measurements' applies. Parent EXP-RUNTIME-35137033384 claim ceiling ('synthetic proxy + CDN simulator with realistic non-determinism' at 1KB JSON) stands; this experiment provides no new evidence about decompression-normalization robustness.
